raw_response: {"diagnosis": "28 raw_transactions rows carry record_version 2: these are re-delivered or corrected versions of existing txn_ids (5003 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_ids). silver_transactions keeps every version, so 27 POSTED txn_ids are duplicated and the gold totals are inflated; keeping only the latest version per txn_id before filtering on status restores correct data.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
